metadata.database: A Deeper China | Guangzhou point decision layer

guest_name_map.GZ010: Canton Tower / Zhujiang New Town decision

GZ001.guest_value: Use morning yum cha to read timing, ordering and shared social space.
GZ001.choose_rule: Choose only after group size, dietary needs, queue tolerance and meal pace are clear.
GZ001.stop_after: One safe, understood meal format is complete.

GZ002.guest_value: Offer a smaller Cantonese food entry when yum cha or a large meal is not a fit.
GZ002.choose_rule: Use explicit ingredient uncertainty; never promise a specific shop or safety.
GZ002.stop_after: One snack/noodle/roast-meat format is understood and safely completed.

GZ003.guest_value: Read foreign settlement, river access and public space without reducing the island to façades.
GZ003.choose_rule: Use one bounded public walk and one historical question.
GZ003.stop_after: The guest can connect river, trade and current public use.

GZ004.guest_value: Show Liwan/Xiguan water, lanes, domestic scale and current life.
GZ004.choose_rule: Use a continuous public route; private homes and courtyards are not attractions.
GZ004.stop_after: One old-city fabric pattern is legible without overextending in humidity.

GZ005.guest_value: Offer a current reuse/creative layer when the visitor wants old-city change.
GZ005.choose_rule: Choose by programme and public use, not by a generic “authentic” claim.
GZ005.stop_after: One reuse relationship is clear; stop before retail wandering.

GZ006.guest_value: Use one clan/craft building to explain traditional Guangzhou form and making.
GZ006.choose_rule: Choose as the main architectural anchor; do not stack every heritage hall.
GZ006.stop_after: One architectural or craft language is understood.

GZ007.guest_value: Potentially extend the architecture/craft question into a slower village context.
GZ007.choose_rule: Only include after current access, transport and active craft purpose are checked.
GZ007.stop_after: The village adds a genuinely new question; otherwise omit the transfer.

GZ008.guest_value: Read arcades, religion and ordinary density in a less polished public route.
GZ008.choose_rule: Use one public sequence and explicit photography/etiquette boundaries.
GZ008.stop_after: One street/arcade pattern is legible without entering private space.

GZ009.guest_value: Make the famous shopping/history trade-off explicit.
GZ009.choose_rule: Use only when shopping or recognisable history fits; do not call it a deep local route.
GZ009.stop_after: The guest decides the commercial layer serves the brief.

GZ010.guest_value: Compare tower, river and new-city public realm without collecting observation decks.
GZ010.choose_rule: Choose by architecture, business or night question and current weather.
GZ010.stop_after: One relationship between river, finance and public realm is clear.

GZ011.guest_value: Use the river at night to close a contemporary-city question.
GZ011.choose_rule: One public edge only; do not promise a particular skyline or cruise.
GZ011.stop_after: The guest has a safe night return and one river/public-space observation.

GZ012.guest_value: Potentially show current creative/urban life beyond formal landmarks.
GZ012.choose_rule: Use only after current programme, venue turnover and late return are checked.
GZ012.stop_after: The current neighbourhood mood answers the visitor’s question.

GZ013.guest_value: Explain wholesale, consumption and trade without promising sourcing access.
GZ013.choose_rule: Define observation, personal purchase or business purpose before entering.
GZ013.stop_after: One market pattern is understood and the guest has a safe exit.

GZ014.guest_value: Protect the first Guangzhou hours from payment, metro, humidity and data failure.
GZ014.choose_rule: Build from airport, hotel, arrival time and actual payment setup.
GZ014.stop_after: The visitor can pay, navigate and reach the next confirmed anchor.

GZ015.guest_value: Keep the route workable during humidity, rain or low energy.
GZ015.choose_rule: Hold as an uncommitted alternative until current weather and opening rules are checked.
GZ015.stop_after: The visitor has recovered without losing the day’s question.

GZ016.guest_value: Give a two-day Guangzhou skeleton without promising comprehensive coverage.
GZ016.choose_rule: Use one food/old-city anchor and one contemporary or recovery branch per day.
GZ016.stop_after: The guest has a realistic reservation order and humidity buffer.

GZ017.guest_value: Frame Guangzhou and Shenzhen as trade/heritage versus technology/urban systems.
GZ017.choose_rule: Require minimum nights and an explicit contrast question.
GZ017.stop_after: The transfer earns a new question and the visitor accepts the cost.

GZ018.guest_value: Pass a Guilin/Yangshuo decision to a separate approved database.
GZ018.choose_rule: Use only when landscape purpose, time and weather tolerance are explicit.
GZ018.stop_after: The guest has made a transfer decision; this is not a full Guilin roadbook.

GZ019.guest_value: Protect a business traveller’s usable cultural window around meetings.
GZ019.choose_rule: Build from actual meeting area and departure constraints; do not add a distant landmark.
GZ019.stop_after: One meaningful public/food/architecture moment fits without risk to work obligations.

GZ020.guest_value: Teach public old-city observation without extracting residents’ private lives.
GZ020.choose_rule: Stay on public routes; no private courtyards, staged encounters or assumed portraits.
GZ020.stop_after: One public pattern is understood without intrusion.
